query:
SELECT 
  d.id, d.nome, d.condominioId,
  c.id as cobrancaId, c.valorOriginal, c.valorAtualizado, c.juros, c.multa, c.honorarios, c.correcaoMonetaria, c.dataVencimento, c.status
FROM devedores d
JOIN cobrancas c ON c.devedorId = d.id
JOIN condominios cond ON cond.id = d.condominioId
WHERE cond.nome LIKE '%Saboya%' OR cond.nome LIKE '%saboya%'
LIMIT 10;
